title: Count On Me
grammarTheme: 以后的事，If 后面当现在说
coreSummary: 就学以后的事。If 后面当现在说，will 放在下一句。

keyTakeawayPatterns.name: 以后的事，If 后面当现在说
keyTakeawayPatterns.exampleInSong: If you ever find yourself stuck in the middle of the sea, I'll sail the world to find you.
keyTakeawayPatterns.dailyExample: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
